about.title: Keep caring is a way of life
body: Headquartered in the capital region of Muscat, Starcare Oman is a network of hospitals, medical centres and pharmacies. More than 500 people work here, including experienced doctors, nurses and paramedics.
Accreditation by JCI, PSFHI and ISO made Starcare the first triple-accredited hospital in the Sultanate. Eighty per cent of our patients are Omani nationals.
more: Starcare Hospital Seeb is a multi-speciality premium hospital designed to the standards of the American Architectural Institute. It offers 24-hour emergency care, outpatient, day-care and inpatient services, modular operating theatres, diagnostic facilities, labour and delivery suites and star-rated inpatient rooms.

The hospitals are managed by Starcare Health Systems Limited, a healthcare management and consultancy company incorporated in the UK and based in Manchester, with operations in Oman, the UAE and India.

items.title: Emergency and urgent care
items.text: A 24-hour emergency department staffed by ACLS-certified doctors and nurses.

detail.intro: The emergency department at Starcare hospital is manned by ACLS certified doctors and nursing staff who are capable of managing all types of emergencies. The department follows internationally accepted ER protocols.
body: The emergency department is a 24-hour fully-equipped medical facility, skilled to provide immediate pain relief, stabilizing the patients, and is the place where you can get immediate medical attention when it is crucially needed.
Call Starcare Seeb on +968 2455 7200 or the emergency line +968 9808 8705.
points: Difficulty in breathing / asthma attacks / pneumonia
Pulmonary embolism ( Blockage of a major blood vessel in the lung)
Altered sensorium (inability to think or concentrate clearly)
Seizures (sudden behavioral change due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain)
Renal colic (blockage in the urinary tract)

items.title: Mother and baby (Starcare Cuddles)
items.text: Birthing suites, Western and Arab midwives, antenatal and delivery packages.

detail.intro: Starcare Cuddles is the group's mother and baby care brand. The Obstetrics & Gynaecology department has a Hill-Rom multifunction birthing bed, star-rated suite rooms with central monitoring, and Western and Arab midwives.
body: Antenatal packages cover 24 to 30 weeks, 30 to 36 weeks, 36 weeks onwards, or the whole pregnancy. Delivery packages cover a planned normal delivery or a planned C-section, with a companion staying in the room.
Each package lists what is excluded, such as emergency C-section, epidural, NICU stay and extra tests, which are charged at the hospital price list.
points: Management of High Risk & Low Risk Pregnancies
Management of Diabetes & Medical Disorders in Pregnancies
Fallopian tube patency tests ( HyCoSy, HSG)
Foetal medicine and detailed anomaly scan
Surgery for Cervical, Uterine and Ovarian Cancer

items.title: Children (Starcare Pedia)
items.text: Paediatrics, neonatology and paediatric surgery in rooms designed for children.

detail.intro: The Paediatric Department is well equipped to provide the various diagnostic evaluations and treatments, every attempt is made to deliver care in a manner that fosters optimal development of the newborn infant as well as incorporates the family into care plan initiatives and is well supported by paediatric specialist consultants. Care is delivered by a dedicated staff of neonatal nurses in collaboration with subspecialty-trained doctors and neonatologists.
body: The Neonatology department in Starcare Hospital is well known for medical care in newborn infants having low birth weight, intrauterine growth retardation, congenital malformations (birth defects), sepsis, or birth asphyxias. The Department of Paediatric Surgery at Starcare hospital is well-equipped to handle all kinds of elective and emergency paediatric and neonatal surgeries. We have one of the best and state-of-the-art operation theatre and paediatric anaesthesia service. We imbibe new and innovative methods for better patient care.
Starcare Pedia is the children's brand, with origami giraffes at reception and its own neonatal intensive care unit brochure.

items.title: Bone, joint and spine
items.text: Joint replacement, arthroscopy, trauma and a spine clinic at Barka.

detail.intro: The Orthopaedic Department at Starcare Hospital is well equipped and caters to all the bone and joint problems. The Department provides advanced diagnostic and treatment facilities in the specialized fields of sports medicine, complete trauma surgery, spinal and paediatric surgery.
body: The team comes from diverse backgrounds, having been trained and experienced in top UK hospitals. The ultra-modern Orthopaedic operation theatres are fitted with the laminar airflow system that keeps them germfree, thus eliminating the risk of infection. It is fully equipped with the latest computer navigated instruments for precision in complex surgeries. Fracture tables, C-arms, arthroscopes, implants and assorted instruments are imported and conform to the highest international standards. The Orthopaedic Department is backed by dedicated & caring nursing staff & trained physical therapists to diagnose, manage, & treat disorders & injuries of the musculoskeletal system including rehabilitation after orthopaedic surgery. Our physiotherapists are trained in the treatment of post-operative orthopaedic procedures, fractures, acute sports injuries, arthritis, sprains, strains, back & neck pain, spinal conditions & amputations.

Starcare Barka opened a Spine Clinic in February 2020, bringing orthopaedic and spine surgeons, physiotherapists and pain specialists into one team. Published package prices at Barka: ACL OMR 1,200 and knee arthroscopy OMR 2,700.
points: Hip and Knee Joint Replacement Surgery (Primary and revision).
Soft Tissue Knee Surgery, ACL Reconstructions

“Back and neck pain can result from a variety of causes, when nerves are stressed by adjacent bones and other tissues. This can happen from regular movements, such as simply bending over or from strenuous activity, trauma, ageing or infection. Having a multidisciplinary team to be able to correctly diagnose wide ranges of spine problems allow us to provide the best patient care possible,”

We specialize in minimally invasive spine surgeries and endoscopic spine surgeries, along with other treatments for common spinal problems like slipped or herniated disc, spondylosis, spinal trauma and fractures, spondylolisthesis and spine tumors etc. It is a multidisciplinary teamwork, making it easier for patients to receive care for a variety of spine and nerve problems, including surgical and non-surgical treatment, rehabilitation and pain management

Endoscopy unit is equipped with advanced video-system and we carry out diagnostic and therapeutic upper and lower endoscopy / Gastroscopy, Colonoscopy, Sigmoideoscopy. At Starcare Hospital, we have a highly experienced team of general surgeons who excel in critical situations and provide a comprehensive, round the clock service for all general surgical procedures. The surgeons are specially trained to conduct emergency surgeries to contain excessive bleeding, bowel obstructions, organ perforations, burns and abdominal trauma. “Back and neck pain can result from a variety of causes, when nerves are stressed by adjacent bones and other tissues. This can happen from regular movements, such as simply bending over or from strenuous activity, trauma, ageing or infection. Having a multidisciplinary team to be able to correctly diagnose wide ranges of spine problems allow us to provide the best patient care possible,”

We specialize in minimally invasive spine surgeries and endoscopic spine surgeries, along with other treatments for common spinal problems like slipped or herniated disc, spondylosis, spinal trauma and fractures, spondylolisthesis and spine tumors etc. It is a multidisciplinary teamwork, making it easier for patients to receive care for a variety of spine and nerve problems, including surgical and non-surgical treatment, rehabilitation and pain management

items.title: Paediatric Cardiology
items.text: Children who have congenital and acquired heart disease need complex, multifaceted care for continued survival and better quality of life.

detail.intro: Children who have congenital and acquired heart disease need complex, multifaceted care for continued survival and better quality of life. Starcare Paediatric Cardiology department educates you and your child about your heart (cardiac) anatomy, future health and potential future heart conditions.
body: The department is dedicated to achieving the best possible outcomes for every patient as well as providing long-term support for every family. At starcare a dedicated team of Paediatric Cardiologists along with the paramedics provides comprehensive evaluation and management for patients with a wide range of congenital and acquired heart disease. Care is provided to patients from fetal life through adolescence and extends to the care of adults with congenital heart disease.
points: Pre – surgical cardiac evaluation for Neonates

items.title: Paediatric Surgery
items.text: The health and wellbeing of the children is most important to the family and the society at large.

detail.intro: The health and wellbeing of the children is most important to the family and the society at large. At Starcare, children are a priority and we aim to please them in the best possible way in stressful situations.
body: Paediatric surgeons specialize in handling surgery needs of newborn till 15 years of age. Many surgical conditions that affect children are significantly different from what is common in adulthood and call for special training, skill and compassionate attitude. The Department at Starcare is already reputed for handling complex surgeries even in newborns, which used to be handled only at Govt Hospitals.
points: Treatment of Anorectal anomalies and hirschsprung disease

items.text: Medical laboratory tests play an important role in detection, diagnosis and treatment of diseases in patients.

detail.intro: Medical laboratory tests play an important role in detection, diagnosis and treatment of diseases in patients. The department of Laboratory Medicine at Starcare covers the complete range of pathology testing services.
body: As part of a JCI accredited hospital, the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are regularly reviewed and updated as per the guidance and recommendations. All tests are performed by qualified professionals and skilled lab technologists who work under strict quality assurance guidelines. The department is also a part of various external quality control programme. We do liaise with ISO 15189 accredited laboratories for rare investigations requests which are not done locally.

items.text: The Paediatric Department is well equipped to provide the various diagnostic evaluations and treatments, every attempt is made to deliver care in a ma

items.text: The Starcare Hospital physiotherapy department is well equipped and aims to rehabilitate and improve the movement disorders in people by using evidenc

detail.intro: The Starcare Hospital physiotherapy department is well equipped and aims to rehabilitate and improve the movement disorders in people by using evidence-based, natural methods such as exercise, motivation, adapted equipment, education and advocacy. Our Physiotherapists are well experienced in medical science subjects such as anatomy, neuroscience and physiology to develop skills and attitudes necessary for health education, prevention, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of patients with physical disorders and disabilities.
body: The techniques employed are advanced and most up to date.

Rehabilitation of conditions like post stroke, Cerebral palsy, Bell’s palsy and various other neurological conditions both in adults and children.
Treatment of conditions like disc related problems, arthritis, tendinitis, joint stiffness, muscular problems etc.
Rehabilitation of post reconstructive surgeries like TKR, THR, ACL reconstruction etc.

Starcare has the availability of in-house Neurologist and visiting Psychologist to complement departments.

The department provides a wide range of diagnostic testing services utilizing state-of-the-art equipment ranging from computed radiology (CR) to multislice CT scan, which is an assurance to the patients of receiving one of the best imaging services.
body: Starcare hospital is equipped with GE Multi slice CT scanner with multi projection volume reconstruction, 3D software surface and volumetric renderings. We also have a high resolution ultrasound scanner with colour Doppler and 4D facilities. Starcare patients are given individual attention by our cordial and professional staff members who are efficient in guiding them through their procedure and answering pertinent questions. The combined use of expertise and technology will help make an accurate diagnosis for all the patients’ health concerns.

items.text: Rheumatologist specialises in the diagnosis and nonsurgical treatment of diseases involving muscles, joints, soft tissues and related connective tissu

detail.intro: Rheumatologist specialises in the diagnosis and nonsurgical treatment of diseases involving muscles, joints, soft tissues and related connective tissue disorders. Rheumatic conditions can be effectively managed with early diagnosis and targeted treatment.
body: With increasing cases of Arthritis and Osteoporosis, the department offers screening clinics for early detection and educating on early symptoms.

Our experts have provided advice and treatment to professional players and athletes in the West, India and GCC region.
body: Apart from the clinical expertise of our internationally experienced faculties, our patients are benefitted from the support facilities like state-of-the-art operation theatres, advanced equipments and surgical techniques like computer assisted navigation surgeries, reliable imaging facilities, Intensive Care Unit and high quality nursing care along with a dedicated rehabilitation team. Our focus is to get you back in action at the shortest time frame possible.

Keyhole (Arthroscopic) Knee, Shoulder, Elbow and Hip surgeries

body: The emergency department is a 24-hour fully-equipped medical facility, skilled to provide immediate pain relief, stabilizing the patients, and is the place where you can get immediate medical attention when it is crucially needed.
points: Difficulty in breathing / asthma attacks / pneumonia
Pulmonary embolism ( Blockage of a major blood vessel in the lung)

Seizures (sudden behavioral change due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain)
Renal colic (blockage in the urinary tract)

items.title: Urology
items.text: Starcare Hospital Urology Department devotes itself to helping with rapid, accurate diagnosis and immediate, effective treatment for a wide range of u

detail.intro: Starcare Hospital Urology Department devotes itself to helping with rapid, accurate diagnosis and immediate, effective treatment for a wide range of urological and genital problems. The department is staffed by consultants with specialized training in Laproscopic surgeries, Lithotripsy and management of common Urological problems.
body: We focus on non-invasive and minimally invasive treatments so that we can give you the best possible results with the minimum amount of discomfort. Over half of all men are affected by prostate problems at some point in their lives, with illnesses ranging from enlarged prostates to prostatitis to prostate cancer. All of these disorders can be uncomfortable, painful and even life threatening. With a wide range of treatment options to cover all stages of disease, our urologists bring you relief using drug therapy, minimally invasive treatment and surgery. We were among the First in Oman in the private health sector to offer Bipolar TURP, which is very safe and minimally invasive treatment for the prostate enlargement. A common disorder, kidney stones is now easier to diagnose and treat. Endoscopic and percutaneous removals are among the many options available at Starcare Hospital. Diagnostic techniques at the Urology Center include all routine & some specialized bladder radiographic analysis to view the bladder urinary system using CT scan & x-rays. Treatment follows to improve bladder control and help regain confidence.
points: Holmium laser now at Starcare, Seeb
All types of kidney, ureter stones can be treated

body: Common procedures include angioplasty and stenting, arterial or venous bypass surgery, and aortic aneurysm repair.

news.title: Starcare re-accredited by JCI for the fourth time
news.summary: Starcare is proud to be re-accredited by Joint Commission International for the fourth time.
body: Starcare announced on 29 August 2021 that it had been re-accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI) for the fourth time in a row.
Starcare Hospital first earned JCI accreditation within its first year of operation. Together with PSFHI and ISO, it made Starcare the first triple-accredited hospital in the Sultanate.

news.title: Starcare Barka launches Spine Clinic
news.summary: A multidisciplinary clinic for back, neck and spine disorders, headed by Dr. Ahmed Jahwari.
body: Barka February 10, 2020: Starcare Hospital, Barka has officially opened a Spine Clinic that bring together the region’s top Ortho/Spine surgeons to provide multidisciplinary, patient-focused care for a variety of back, neck and spine disorders. The Clinic is headed by Dr. Ahmed Jahwari, MD, FRCS CANADA, Sr. Consultant- Orthopaedic & Trauma Care. The Orthopaedic & Spine Clinic at Starcare Barka has full-fledged team of experienced surgeons, Dr.Paul P Antony, MBBS, MS (Orthopedics) SICOT Fellow Shoulder & Elbow Surgery (Germany) AO Fellow (Germany).

Dr.Raphael Charrabeh, MD Orthopedic & Trauma Specialty (Syrian Board) and Dr.Ahmed Said Ali Al-Mandhari, BSc, MD, MRCS , MCCE, ( Fellow in shoulder and Elbow surgery - UK ). Expert Physiotherapists are also part of the Spine care Team. Dr. Ahmed Jahwari completed his graduation from Sultan Qaboos University, Oman and MD from College of Medicine SQU. He is a certified Orthopedic Surgeon from the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.

He is honored and awarded with Best Trainer of the Year OMSB, Bernard Ghert Award for resident excellence in patient focused care, University of Toronto, Zimmer Research Grant Awarded 1st prize and has received an honor degree from Sultan Qaboos University. “Back and Neck pain are most common health issues for a large number of people. However, there are many misconceptions and fear among people regarding the results of treatment of spinal problems.

Many people put up with the suffering rather than getting correct treatment simply because of lack of awareness about what all modern Spine care treatment methods can offer” said Dr. Sadik Kodakat, Consultant Anesthesiologist & Chairman of Starcare Group in the press meet conducted at the Hospital in Barka. Mr. Nasser Batha Group CEO of Starcare Oman added that, with the addition of Spine Clinic in the orthopedic division of Starcare Barka, we intend to provide accurate diagnosis, choose best treatment, and execute the treatment in best possible manner for every single patient.

Surgery option chosen only when non-surgical treatment fails to provide adequate relief to the patient. When needed, surgeries will be carried out with the latest technologies at our well-equipped operation theaters. We specialize in minimally invasive spine surgeries and endoscopic spine surgeries, along with other treatments for common spinal problems like slipped or herniated disc, spondylosis, spinal trauma and fractures, spondylolisthesis and spine tumors etc.

It is a multidisciplinary teamwork, making it easier for patients to receive care for a variety of spine and nerve problems, including surgical and non-surgical treatment, rehabilitation and pain management said Dr. Ahmed Jahwari “Back and neck pain can result from a variety of causes, when nerves are stressed by adjacent bones and other tissues. This can happen from regular movements, such as simply bending over or from strenuous activity, trauma, ageing or infection.

Having a multi-disciplinary team to be able to correctly diagnose wide ranges of spine problems allow us to provide the best patient care possible.,” “We are all working together for the patient’s best interests in mind.” He added. Starcare Barka has strived to provide the services of experienced and well known doctors and Senior Visiting Consultants from different specialties including Orthopedic Surgeries, weight reduction surgery, Gynecologic Laparoscopic Surgery, Pediatric Surgery and ENT surgeries.

Now it has become the preferred centre for complex orthopedic surgeries like joint replacement, shoulder arthroscopy and Spine surgeries. We were in the news last year for doing the first Shoulder Joint Replacement surgery in the private sector in Oman. We are now looking forward to be the Centre of Excellence in Spine care” Said Mr. Vinod, Chief Operating officer of Starcare Hospital Barka.

news.title: Starcare wins best employer award
news.summary: World HRD Congress named Starcare the Best Employer for Oman in Healthcare, 2019.
body: Starcare hospital has been selected by the prestigious World HRD Congress as the Best Employer for Oman in Healthcare, 2019 after carefully considering multiple parameters including diversified culture, equal opportunity for women leaders, employee benefits and engagements, empowering and developing Omani nationals. “People are the backbone of our organisation and the most valuable assets. We consider it as a symbiotic relationship extending value to each other,” remarked Nasser Batha, CEO, Starcare Group.

The 28th edition of the World HRD Congress aims to recognise the efforts of the healthcare organisations that have strived to attract and retain talent. Featuring the best organisations in Oman, Starcare Group was selected by World HRD Congress as the Preferred Employer in healthcare by the international jury. “At Starcare we aim to promote the professional and personal growth of the employees, it is important to maintain a healthy work-life balance to attain productivity”, commented Dr Sadik Kodakat, chairman of Starcare Group, expressing his happiness on being selected as the best employer.

The Starcare family has a staff strength of more than 500 employees and growing with its presence in three countries including Oman, India and UAE. The group is always in line with the government vision to enhance Omanisation. A culture of patient safety and care beyond everything else runs deep in the vein of the organisation helping to bridge the differences in nationality, language and training. The private healthcare sector in Oman has been at the forefront driving the changes and ushering progress and technological advancements in the field.

Established in 2010, Starcare Group has since then redefined the standards of healthcare delivery and established itself as the benchmark for quality healthcare. Having achieved the rare feat of JCI accreditation, the gold standard for healthcare excellence in less than a year of operation, Starcare has been on a continuous search for improvement and excellence. Healthcare more than any other industry depends on the people, their expertise and passionate approach to achieving success.

“I always knew that Starcare is one of the good places to work because I have so many fond memories during my last five years here. Now I am really excited to hear that our team has been appreciated by independent experts in the field too,” said Mariyam Juma al Balushi, a supervisor at Customer Care in Mawaleh branch. Starcare group has hospitals in Seeb, Barka and medical centres in Bausher, Ma’abela and Duqm. A brand new 80-bed Mother & Child Hospital will come up in Al Hail in 2020.

news.title: Starcare names Nasser Batha as group CEO
news.summary: The founding partner takes charge of the hospitals at Seeb and Barka and the medical centres at Bowsher, Mabela and Duqm.
body: The Starcare Group which started its journey in 2010 in Oman has made remarkable progress in establishing itself as the benchmark for accreditation quality healthcare in the country. The group has expanded its footprints beyond Oman to India and UAE in the past years apart from the ambitious super speciality projects in progress. Clearly, on the verge of a new horizon, the group is in need of strong and multifaceted leader with astute business acumen.

The Chairman and Board of Directors unanimously nominated Mr Nasser Batha, Founding Partner of the Group to assume responsibility as the CEO of Starcare Group in Oman. A sought after management professional and a passionate entrepreneur, Nasser Batha has been heading business units of international brands like EMAAR, AMADEUS, Emirates, KLM and others across the globe in an extensive career spanning 3 decades. Hailed for expansions, start-ups and turnaround ventures, he demonstrates pro-active leadership and ability to deliver financial and business growth.

An MBA from Bradford, UK, Nasser keeps abreast with the developments in the field and remains a strong advocate of technology and innovation. Welcoming the new CEO, Dr Sadik Kodakat, Chairman, Starcare Group remarked “Nasser has always been part of the key decisions and strategies made by Starcare. But now, we will have his dedicated attention to the business as we pursue our ambitious growth plans in Oman”. An analytical thinker and quick decision maker, Nasser benefits from his vast experience in the Middle East and Europe part from his ability to handle seven languages.

He would be responsible for all the operating units of Starcare in Oman including hospitals at Seeb, Barka and Medical Centres at Bowsher, Mabela and Duqm. “We hope the new CEO would be able to shape the Corporate strategy in line with the expansion plans of the group and the specific requirements of Oman.” said Dr Askar Kukkadi, Managing Director, Starcare Group. The healthcare sector in Oman is undergoing rapid changes highlighted by the presence of private hospitals and the government initiatives to encourage private sector and PPP ventures.

Oman is a youthful country with strong economic indicators and rising population along with prevalence of chronic diseases indicating the need for customized healthcare solutions. Starcare has always believed in adapting the Western standards of quality to suit the healthcare requirements of the nation. “It is my personal goal to increase opportunities for Omani nationals, train and enhance their skills in the process to develop a sustainable healthcare delivery model” commented Nasser Batha in his interaction with the staff members.
The group is planning to add 400 beds in the next 5 years including the prestigious Starcare Healthcity Muscat and a chain of low-cost clinics.

faq.a: Yes. Starcare holds JCI, PSFHI and ISO accreditation, which made it the first triple-accredited hospital in Oman. JCI re-accredited Starcare for the fourth time in August 2021.
Starcare Hospital Seeb runs a 24-hour emergency department staffed by ACLS-certified doctors and nurses. Call +968 2455 7200 or +968 9808 8705.

Starcare works with most insurers and TPAs for cashless or direct billing, including Aetna, AXA, Bupa, Cigna, MedNet, MSH International, NEXtCARE, SAICO, Vipul BetterCare and MetLife. Starcare Barka also accepts National Life & General Insurance cards. Check your policy with the branch before your visit.

faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Call your branch, or use the form on this site. Starcare Barka also takes appointment requests by WhatsApp on +968 9331 7359.

faq.q: What does the 24 to 30 week antenatal package include?
faq.a: Nine consultations with a consultant obstetrician, two ultrasound scans, two full blood counts and a dipstick urine test at each visit. Other tests, admissions and extra consultations are charged separately.

faq.q: What is in the normal delivery package?
faq.a: A planned, uncomplicated delivery with 1 night and 2 days for mother and baby in a standard room, meals, a companion, routine tests, the baby's BCG and hepatitis B vaccines, a hearing screen and follow-ups with the paediatrician and obstetrician within two weeks.
It depends on your sex, age and lifestyle risk factors. Call +968 9808 8705 or +968 2455 7200 and the team will suggest one.
Hospitals in Seeb and Barka, medical centres in Mabela, Bousher and Duqm, a clinic in Saha (Samail), and branches in Rolla, Sharjah and in Calicut, India.
